User: Typically, I go with my family and I'll pick it up or they'll bring it home or maybe someone in my family will bring it home. And I choose it because it's a store that's close to where we live. You know, a restaurant that's close to where we live. And usually, I don't have to buy a lot of, I wouldn't have to buy extras. Like when you buy a burger, you have to get fries and everything. But the Mexican pizza is enough for me. That and a drink is all I need. So that's typically why I would choose that most often.
Agent: That's very helpful. How does price change your choice? For example, if the Mexican Pizza cost two dollars more, what would you do?
